maddeler.e:
أعتنق (form VIII)
# أَعْتَنِقُ (ʔaʕtaniqu) /ʔaʕ.ta.ni.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# أُعْتَنَقُ (ʔuʕtanaqu) /ʔuʕ.ta.na.qu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# أَعْتَنِقَ (ʔaʕtaniqa) /ʔaʕ.ta.ni.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# أُعْتَنَقَ (ʔuʕtanaqa) /ʔuʕ.ta.na
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
